Both successful and failed operations are retained for 30 days after completion. Use the `operation_type` and `status` query parameters to filter results. Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04), assistant_name. Optional: operation_type, status, limit (plus 1 more).

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: assistant_name
params.description: The name of the assistant to list operations for.

params.name: operation_type
params.description: Filter operations by type.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter operations by status.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit on the number of operations to return.

params.name: pagination_token
params.description: Pagination token to continue a previous listing operation.

tools.name: query_vectors
tools.description: Search a namespace using a query vector. It retrieves the ids of the most similar items in a namespace, along with their similarity scores. For guidance, examples, and limits, see [Search](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/search-overview). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04), topK. Optional: filter, id, includeMetadata (default: false) (plus 7 more). Returns the new QueryResponse.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: filter
params.description: The filter to apply. You can use vector metadata to limit your search. See [Understanding metadata](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview#metadata).

params.name: id
params.description: The unique ID of the vector to be used as a query vector. Each request can contain either the `vector` or `id` parameter.

params.name: includeMetadata
params.description: Indicates whether metadata is included in the response as well as the ids.

params.name: includeValues
params.description: Indicates whether vector values are included in the response. For on-demand indexes, setting this to `true` may increase latency, especially with higher `topK` values, because vector values are retrieved from object storage. Unless you need vector values, set this to `false` for better performance.

params.name: maxCandidates
params.description: An optimization parameter that controls the maximum number of candidate dense vectors to rerank. Reranking computes exact distances to improve recall but increases query latency. Range: top_k – 100000. Keep the default for a balance of recall and latency. Increase this value if recall is too low, or decrease it to reduce latency at the cost of accuracy. This parameter is only supported for dedicated (DRN) dense indexes.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to query.

params.name: queries
params.description: DEPRECATED. Use `vector` or `id` instead.

params.name: scanFactor
params.description: An optimization parameter for IVF dense indexes in dedicated read node indexes. It adjusts how much of the index is scanned to find vector candidates. Range: 0.5 – 4 (default). Keep the default (4.0) for the best search results. If query latency is too high, try lowering this value incrementally (minimum 0.5) to speed up the search at the cost of slightly lower accuracy. This parameter is only supported for dedicated (DRN) dense indexes.

params.name: sparse-vector-indices
params.description: The indices of the sparse data.

params.name: sparse-vector-values
params.description: The corresponding values of the sparse data, which must be with the same length as the indices.

params.name: topK
params.description: The number of results to return for each query.

params.name: vector
params.description: The query vector. This should be the same length as the dimension of the index being queried. Each `query` request can contain only one of the parameters `id` or `vector`.

tools.name: records_search-namespace
tools.description: Search a namespace with a query text, query vector, or record ID and return the most similar records, along with their similarity scores. Optionally, rerank the initial results based on their relevance to the query. Searching with text is supported only for indexes with [integrated embedding](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview#vector-embedding). Searching with a query vector or record ID is supported for all indexes. For guidance and examples, see [Search](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/search-overview). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04), namespace, query. Optional: fields, rerank. Returns the new SearchRecordsResponse.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to search.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to return in the search results. If not specified, the response will include all fields.

params.name: query-filter
params.description: The filter to apply. You can use vector metadata to limit your search. See [Understanding metadata](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview#metadata).

params.name: query-id
params.description: The unique ID of the vector to be used as a query vector.

params.name: query-inputs
params.description: Inputs

params.name: query-match-terms-strategy
params.description: The strategy for matching terms in the text. Currently, only `all` is supported, which means all specified terms must be present.

params.name: query-match-terms-terms
params.description: A list of terms that must be present in the text of each search hit based on the specified strategy.

params.name: query-top-k
params.description: The number of similar records to return.

params.name: query-vector-sparse-indices
params.description: The sparse embedding indices.

params.name: query-vector-sparse-values
params.description: The sparse embedding values.

params.name: query-vector-values
params.description: This is the vector data included in the request.

params.name: rerank-model
params.description: The name of the [reranking model](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/rerank-results#reranking-models) to use.

params.name: rerank-parameters
params.description: Additional model-specific parameters. Refer to the [model guide](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/rerank-results#reranking-models) for available model parameters.

params.name: rerank-query
params.description: The query to rerank documents against. If a specific rerank query is specified, it overwrites the query input that was provided at the top level.

params.name: rerank-rank-fields
params.description: The field(s) to consider for reranking. If not provided, the default is `['text']`. The number of fields supported is [model-specific](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/rerank-results#reranking-models).

params.name: rerank-top-n
params.description: The number of top results to return after reranking. Defaults to top_k.

tools.name: records_upsert-namespace
tools.description: Upsert text into a namespace. Pinecone converts the text to vectors automatically using the hosted embedding model associated with the index. Upserting text is supported only for [indexes with integrated embedding](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/create-an-index#embedding-models). For guidance, examples, and limits, see [Upsert data](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/upsert-data). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04), namespace.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to upsert records into.

tools.name: rerank_rerank
tools.description: Rerank results according to their relevance to a query. For guidance and examples, see [Rerank results](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/rerank-results). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04), documents, model, query. Optional: parameters, rank_fields (default: [text]), return_documents (default: true) (plus 1 more). Returns array of RankedDocument.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: documents
params.description: The documents to rerank.

params.name: model
params.description: The [model](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/rerank-results#reranking-models) to use for reranking.

params.name: parameters
params.description: Additional model-specific parameters. Refer to the [model guide](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/rerank-results#reranking-models) for available model parameters.

params.name: query
params.description: The query to rerank documents against.

params.name: rank_fields
params.description: The field(s) to consider for reranking. If not provided, the default is `['text']`. The number of fields supported is [model-specific](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/search/rerank-results#reranking-models).

params.name: return_documents
params.description: Whether to return the documents in the response.

params.name: top_n
params.description: The number of results to return sorted by relevance. Defaults to the number of inputs.

tools.name: restore-jobs_describe
tools.description: Get a description of a restore job. Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04), job_id. Returns the RestoreJobModel.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: job_id
params.description: The ID of the restore job to describe.

tools.name: restore-jobs_list
tools.description: List all restore jobs for a project. Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04). Optional: limit (default: 10), paginationToken. Returns array of RestoreJobModel.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

params.name: paginationToken
params.description: The token to use to retrieve the next page of results.

tools.name: vectors_delete
tools.description: Delete records by id or by metadata from a single namespace. For guidance and examples, see [Delete data](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/delete-data). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04). Optional: deleteAll (default: false), filter, ids (plus 1 more). Returns the new DeleteResponse.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: deleteAll
params.description: This indicates that all vectors in the index namespace should be deleted.

params.name: filter
params.description: If specified, the metadata filter here will be used to select the vectors to delete. This is mutually exclusive with specifying ids to delete in the ids param or using delete_all=True. See [Delete data](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/delete-data#delete-records-by-metadata).

params.name: ids
params.description: Vectors to delete.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to delete records from, if applicable.

tools.name: vectors_fetch
tools.description: Look up and return records by ID from a single namespace. The returned records include the vector data and/or metadata. For on-demand indexes, since vector values are retrieved from object storage, fetch operations may have increased latency. If you only need metadata or IDs, consider using the query operation with `includeValues` set to `false` instead. For guidance and examples, see [Fetch data](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/fetch-data). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04), ids. Optional: namespace. Returns the FetchResponse.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: ids
params.description: The vector IDs to fetch. Does not accept values containing spaces.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to fetch records from. If not provided, the default namespace is used.

tools.name: vectors_fetch-by-metadata
tools.description: Look up and return records by metadata from a single namespace. The returned records include the vector data and metadata. For guidance and examples, see [Fetch data](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/fetch-data). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04). Optional: filter, limit (default: 100), namespace (plus 1 more). Returns the new FetchByMetadataResponse.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: filter
params.description: Metadata filter expression to select vectors. See [Understanding metadata](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview#metadata).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of vectors to return.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to fetch records from.

params.name: paginationToken
params.description: Pagination token to continue a previous listing operation.

tools.name: vectors_list
tools.description: List the IDs of records in a single namespace of a serverless index. An optional prefix can be passed to limit the results to IDs with a common prefix. Returns up to 100 IDs at a time by default in sorted order (bitwise 'C' collation). If the `limit` parameter is set, `list` returns up to that number of IDs instead. Whenever there are additional IDs to return, the response also includes a `pagination_token` that you can use to get the next batch of IDs. When the response does not include a `pagination_token`, there are no more IDs to return. For guidance and examples, see [List record IDs](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/list-record-ids). **Note:** `list` is supported only for serverless indexes. Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04). Optional: prefix, limit (default: 100), paginationToken (plus 1 more).

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: prefix
params.description: The vector IDs to fetch. Does not accept values containing spaces.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of IDs to return per page.

params.name: paginationToken
params.description: Pagination token to continue a previous listing operation.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to list vectors from. If not provided, the default namespace is used.

tools.name: vectors_update
tools.description: Update records by ID or by metadata in a namespace. Updating by ID changes the vector and/or metadata of a single record. Updating by metadata changes metadata across multiple records using a metadata filter. If a vector value is included, it will overwrite the previous value. If `set_metadata` is included, only the specified metadata fields are modified, and if a specified metadata field does not exist, it is added. For guidance and examples, see [Update data](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/update-data). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04). Optional: dryRun (default: false), filter, id (plus 4 more). Returns the new UpdateResponse.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: dryRun
params.description: If `true`, return the number of records that match the `filter`, but do not execute the update. Default is `false`.

params.name: filter
params.description: A metadata filter expression. When updating metadata across records in a namespace, the update is applied to all records that match the filter. See [Understanding metadata](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview#metadata).

params.name: id
params.description: Vector's unique id.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace containing the record to update.

params.name: setMetadata
params.description: Metadata to set for the record.

params.name: sparse-values-indices
params.description: The indices of the sparse data.

params.name: sparse-values-values
params.description: The corresponding values of the sparse data, which must be with the same length as the indices.

params.name: values
params.description: Vector data.

tools.name: vectors_upsert
tools.description: Upsert records into a namespace. If a new value is upserted for an existing record ID, it will overwrite the previous value. For guidance, examples, and limits, see [Upsert data](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/upsert-data). Required: X-Pinecone-Api-Version (default: 2026-04), vectors. Optional: namespace. Returns the new UpsertResponse.

params.name: X-Pinecone-Api-Version
params.description: Required date-based version header

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace where you upsert records.

params.name: vectors
params.description: An array containing the vectors to upsert. Recommended batch limit is up to 1000 vectors.
